description: Four scripted Mac clients show one board. Ordinary calls follow focus; browser reload stays with the persisted drawing machine. A timeout or disconnect fails a call without retrying another client. A diagram whose zero-timeout reload returned loaded:false publishes an error when its viewer disconnects later.
